methodology: Individual-sense review by the coding assistant (model-assisted semantic curation). Candidate headwords were searched for discovery, then each selected exact English translation heading and part of speech was inspected and assigned explicitly by concept ID. Homonymous senses were not grouped by headword. Each record preserves the selected dictionary heading, POS, source URL, source hash and source order. No translations or CEFR labels are invented by this supplement. This is category curation, not independent native-speaker verification of every source translation. All selected source concepts have Turkish and at least eight language forms; coverage counts describe source availability before application quality screening. Associations already present in earlier reviewed supplements are omitted. Furniture and color coverage is constrained by available attested senses; unrelated senses are not included to reach numerical targets.
